Your member account

Build a stronger Franklin Navigator presence and help increase your visibility in the Franklin community. See your membership, connected profile, benefits, billing and profile tools in one place. Existing members do not need to go through signup again.

Complete your member profile

Start with the highest-value actions.

Use this simple sequence to make your Franklin Navigator presence more recognizable, complete and useful to local residents. You can return to any step later.

1 · Add your logo or profile image

Manage the approved image that represents your business, then add eligible Community Member cover or gallery media.

Manage profile media

2 · Review your business information

Check your description, services, hours and supported website, contact, booking, quote, menu/order or other customer-action links.

Review profile details

3 · Add offers or an event

Create a reviewed coupon, special, sale, promotion or upcoming event, then add an eligible promotional graphic, flyer image or reviewed PDF document.

Manage promotions & events

4 · Preview your public presence

Review how your enhanced member profile is presented before relying on it in customer outreach or promotion.

Preview member profile

Community Membership is optional. Claiming the basic profile, factual corrections, removal requests and legitimate free-profile management remain free.
